text:
priya_platform: Heads-up — delivery milestone tomorrow EOD for OptKit v0.9. Need final ownership & unblock list for quant/batch/cache. Quick async check: who owns final quant recommendations + canary? Also saw a regression alert on staging (p95 token latency spike after a quant change) — @sanjay_sre can you confirm?

carla_ops: I can own rollout orchestration (canary + rollback). Will coordinate with SRE for traffic split. Need to know which model variants to include. :+1:

mike_ml: I can finalize quant recs. Current PR: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/421 — uses int8 per-channel for attention kernels. Bench numbers in PR. Note: QAT not viable for this pass; doing post-training quantization with calibration.

zhang_runtime: Runtime change on branch `runtime/kv-cache` has been merged but batching behavior changed — might interact with quant. Pinged @deploy-bot to schedule a controlled canary once we have owners.

sanjay_sre: Confirmed the alert. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/staging/alerts/8932. Early signal looks like coalescing policy + quantized kernels causing occasional stalls under specific sequence-length mixes. Investigating root cause.

carla_ops: Proposed canary plan: 10% traffic for 2h, then 30% for 1h if stable, then ramp. Owners: @mike_ml (quant), @zhang_runtime (runtime), @carla_ops (orchestration).

priya_platform: Assigning tasks: mike — finalize quant PR and add evals against prompt set `optkit_regress_v2`; zhang — ensure kernel fallback for qlinear and add a runtime flag `--force-fp32-attn-kernel`; carla — create canary runbook and schedule.

mike_ml: On it. I'll add evals and include this config snippet in the PR:
```
quant_scheme: int8_per_channel
calibration: dynamic
skip_bias_fold: true
```
Also adding ablation for KV-cache size and batch window.

zhang_runtime: Added fallback flag on branch `runtime/quant-fallback`. Example CLI: `./serve --model mymodel --quant-allow-fallback`. Kernel selection now prefers fp32 if fallback tripped. Will open PR #189.

priya_platform: Please review PRs: mike #421, zhang #189. If no major issues by 16:00 PT I'll kick canary at 17:00 PT.

sanjay_sre: Set alert policy: if canary p95 > 1.5x baseline we auto-roll back. Hooked alerts to pager and to deploy-bot. :warning:

deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled: canary-window 2026-03-17T17:00 PT; will notify on failures.

mike_ml: Quick question — who will own docs update at docs/optkit/quant.md? I can PR if someone can do a quick review.

carla_ops: I will review the doc PR. Also need a delivery contact for customer-facing regression communications — @sanjay_sre?

sanjay_sre: Yes, I'll take customer-facing alerts and postmortem if needed.

priya_platform: Thanks all. I'll draft the release note (short) after canary: quant recs + batching improvements. Keep this thread for status updates; ping me if you hit blockers. :eyes:

carla_ops: Noted — tagging follow-ups in the runbook.

mike_ml: PRs updated, added eval outputs and perf table. @carla_ops can you glance?

carla_ops: Looking now, plz @mention me on the PR for review.

zhang_runtime: If SRE wants a temp rollback knob, I added `--disable-quant-kernel` in the runtime args. Helps urgent rollbacks without redeploy.

sanjay_sre: Nice — that will be useful. Continuing to watch staging, will update if I find a clear repro.

deploy-bot: Canary will run at scheduled time. Will post summary to #incidents if anything fires.

priya_platform: Great. Closing the ownership loop: mike = quant + evals, zhang = kernel fallback + runtime flag, carla = canary orchestration + doc review, sanjay = SRE + customer comms. Thank you. :thumbsup:
